Product Description

2025-26 Topps Chrome Update Series Basketball is headlined by one of the most coveted cards in the hobby, Rookie Debut Patch Autographs, making their Topps Basketball debut. Considered a pinnacle chase across The Hobby, these one-of-one grails, featuring game-worn NBA Debut patches, arrive for the first time in basketball with standout rookies like Cooper Flagg, Kon Knueppel, and Dylan Harper leading the charge. The chase is rounded out by superstars such as Stephen Curry, LeBron James, Victor Wembanyama, Anthony Edwards, Nikola Jokić, and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and more across major SSPs and Autographs.

Each Hobby Pack of 2025-2026 Topps Chrome Updates Basketball contains four cards. Each box contains one autograph. Look for Refractors, Prism Refractors, inserts, case hit inserts, and NBA Debut Patch Autographs.

The 200-card base set features refreshed imagery for the rookies, vets, and legends, all showcased in updated, in-season photography featuring Statement, City and Classic Edition uniforms and of course, a deep rainbow of Chrome parallels. Collectors can also hunt a wide range of new inserts including New Edition, Stratospheric Stars, No Limit, and Moment in Time, highlighting iconic NBA moments like Curry's "Ring Me" celebration in the NBA Finals.

Beyond the Rookie Debut Patch Autographs, chase elements run deep with exciting case hits like the NBA's first Alter Egos SSPs, an epic 10-card set that transforms each player into a dynamic, illustrated, super-powered persona. Minions NBA are SSPs that reimagine NBA stars as Minions in collaboration with Illumination for a fun, highly collectible crossover insert. In addition, look out for the Denim Tears SSP parallel, and newly added Captains, Celebración case hit inserts.

Autograph collectors can chase a robust lineup of Topps Chrome Autographs, including special appearances from Druski and Spike Lee. The 1980–81 Topps Basketball Autographs deliver another loaded checklist, while the ultra-cool Lava Lamp Rookie Autographs add a groovy twist. Chrome Updates Basketball is a must-have release, bursting with star power, innovation, and true hobby heat.

Topps Chrome Updates brings the season to life with dynamic, refreshed photography, capturing the biggest stars and rising rookies in their latest looks. Chrome Updates expands on the flagship Chrome lineup with new additions and timely storytelling from across the league. Built on the signature shine, premium feel, and dynamic design collectors expect from Topps Chrome, Updates delivers a remix that keeps The Hobby aligned with the current moment.

references.text:
2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball Guide - Topps Ripped

Discover 2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball

Date: Aug 27, 2026

Topics: 2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball, Basketball, Instant Packs, NBA, SKU Guide, Trending

Length: 1830 Words

Reading Time: ~10 Minutes

2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball brings back its signature dark aesthetic, pairing bold card designs with a premium chromium finish. Collectors can find the biggest names in basketball, from established stars like Victor Wembanyama, LeBron James, and Stephen Curry to exciting rookies like Cooper Flagg, Dylan Harper, and Kon Knueppel.

The insert lineup features returning favorites Black Lightning, Nocturnal, and Home Court, joined by two new additions, Carbon Flare and Obscura.

The autograph lineup runs just as deep, with Autographs, Rookie Autographs, Ivory Autographs, Super Futures Autographs, and the new Glow Up Signatures joining Carbon Ink, Black Fire Autographs, and Shrouded Signatures. Every box includes numbered parallels and one encased autograph card.

2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball comes in two formats: physical Hobby boxes and the new Instant Packs available on Fanatics Collect. Both draw from the same print run and checklist, so the right format depends on whether you want to open sealed wax at home or rip instantly online. Here’s a breakdown of what each format offers.

2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball is available in two formats: physical Hobby boxes and digital Instant Packs on Fanatics Collect. Every Hobby box includes two packs of six cards plus one encased autograph card, while Instant Packs deliver four cards from the same print run, plus two exclusive parallels. Collectors can find Victor Wembanyama, LeBron James, Stephen Curry, and top rookies like Cooper Flagg, Dylan Harper, and Kon Knueppel across a signature dark chromium design.

2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball Format Comparison

FormatConfigurationKey DrawBest ForHobbyTwo packs per box, six cards per pack, plus one encased autograph card. Eight boxes per caseAn encased autograph card in every box, backed by a full parallel and insert lineupCollectors who want the full physical Chrome Black experience with sealed wax at homeInstant PacksFour cards per pack, six-pack daily limit per collector, available on Fanatics CollectTwo exclusive parallels, Black Glitter numbered to /11 and Teal Glitter numbered to /64Collectors who want to rip instantly online without waiting on shipping

DISCOVER NOW

2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball Hobby Box

Each Hobby box of 2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball includes two packs of six cards and one additional encased autograph card. Eight boxes make up a case, and every box includes numbered parallels drawn from the Base Card Parallel Matrix, which runs from the Base Refractor, numbered to 299, up through the one-of-one Base SuperFractor.

That encased autograph card is the anchor of every box, drawing from a signature lineup that includes Autographs, Rookie Autographs, Carbon Ink, Super Futures Autographs, Black Fire Autographs, Shrouded Signatures, Glow Up Signatures, and Ivory Autographs. Collectors can also find insert cards from Black Lightning, Nocturnal, Home Court, Carbon Flare, and Obscura mixed throughout the base packs.

Built around a premium autograph anchor and a deep parallel ladder, Hobby is the way to experience 2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball as a sealed, physical product.

2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball Instant Packs

Our newest format, Instant Packs are digital rips of real, physical 2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball cards. Topps set aside 10 percent of the Chrome Black Basketball print run for this format, ripped on Fanatics Collect. Every card has already been scanned in, so the card a collector sees when ripping is the exact physical card they’ll receive if they ship it home. Aside from two exclusive parallels, the checklist matches the physical Hobby release.

Each pack costs $100 and includes four cards, with a daily limit of six packs per collector. Instant Packs release on August 27 at 4 p.m. ET / 1 p.m. PT and are available to US collectors only.

The two Instant Packs exclusive parallels are Black Glitter, numbered to /11, and Teal Glitter, numbered to /64. Everything else matches the physical release checklist, giving collectors a way to rip the same print run instantly instead of waiting on shipping.

RIP INSTANT PACKS NOW

So, What Format Should You Get?

If you want the full physical experience, sealed wax, an encased autograph card in every box, and a deep parallel and insert lineup to work through, Hobby is the easy call. Collectors who want to rip the same print run instantly, without waiting on shipping, and pick up two exclusive parallels found nowhere else should look to Instant Packs on Fanatics Collect.

What to Look For

Black Lightning, Nocturnal, and Home Court: Three returning insert sets bring back the dark, dramatic design work Chrome Black

The Home launcher
To enjoy the benefits of your Android TV, connect the

is the center of your TV. From here you can decide
what to watch by browsing entertainment options

you discover great contents from your favorite apps.
You can also add additional channels or find new
apps to get more contents.
The Home screen is organized in channels. Apps may
populate their recommendation (if available)
according to their own choice as an individual
channels in the home screen.
Apps
Your favorite Apps are placed on the first row. This
row contains a number of pre-installed apps. The
order of these apps is according to business
agreements with content service providers. You can
also add more apps as favorite from the Apps page,
such as the Live TV and MMP (MultiMediaPlayer). The
Apps page can be opened by clicking the Apps icon
at the left end of the Apps row.
Live TV
The Live TV row shows the currently running
programs from the installed channels. It contains up
to 10 channels as the recommendation for you to
select the TV channels. The first channel on Live TV
row is the channel you are watching, and the
following channels will be the channels on your
favorites list*.

The best remotes with voice control let you ditch the pile of clickers and run your whole entertainment center by voice.

Voice Control Is Here

Buck Rogers and his robot Twiggy

Alright Buck Rogers, so you want the scoop on voice-control remotes. I get it. Searching around in the bowels of your sofa or favorite E-Z chair among the crumbs for that ever-elusive remote does get tiresome.

Apparently, we are in good company. Research by Statista found that around 44% of surveyed U.S. households have a TV remote capable of voice control. This was surprisingly higher than I was expecting.

So which remote is right for you?

Fear not. Below, I review the seven top voice-control remotes, ranked by who they actually serve. Most work with both Alexa and Google Assistant.

★ Editor’s Choice

The best remote with voice control right now is the SofaBaton X2. Its 2.4-inch color touchscreen, fast Alexa and Google Assistant response, and refined hub control over IR, Bluetooth, RF, and Wi-Fi devices make it the smartest voice-remote purchase you can make today.

Compatibility: 500,000+ devices from 6,000 brands via IR, Bluetooth, RF, and Wi-Fi.

Best For: A full living room with TV, soundbar, streamer, and smart-home gear consolidated to one remote.

Release information

This card was included in the Base Set, first released in the Japanese Expansion Pack. A 1st Edition version of this card was included in the 2-Player Starter Set, with the Shadowless variant being available in the first (Shadowless) print of the Set and the non-Shadowless being available in the second print. While an Unlimited Edition version of the Base Set print of this card was never officially released, a Non Holofoil version of this card lacking the 1st Edition stamp was included in the Trainer Deck A, distributed to prototype Pokémon Leagues before the TCG officially launched in North America. Like the rest of the cards included in the deck, this print has a red border and "Trainer Deck A" printed on the back. Another 1st Edition Base Set version of this card, with the Cosmos Holofoil treatment, was included in the 2-Player CD-ROM Starter Set released alongside Base Set 2, which was only released outside of Japan. This card was reprinted in the Legendary Collection expansion, which was also only released outside of Japan.

Trivia

Origin

Strikes Back's Japanese name is that of Counterattack, a skill later introduced in Pokémon Shuffle. Seismic Toss is a move in the Pokémon games that Machamp can learn. This card's English Pokédex entry comes from Pokémon Red and Blue, though it is slightly reworded. The Japanese entry comes from Pokémon Red and Green.
